name: 020-vat-treatment-snapshots
statements: CREATE TABLE migration_020_fresh_guard(fact_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(fact_count=0))STRICT

INSERT INTO migration_020_fresh_guard SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issuer_tax_configurations)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draft_lines)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issued_lines)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issued_tax_breakdown)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proforma_lines)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proforma_tax_breakdown)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM correction_lines)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM correction_tax_breakdown)

CREATE TABLE issuer_tax_configurations(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,effective_to TEXT,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,code,effective_from),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id)REFERENCES issuers(organization_id)ON DELETE CASCADE,CHECK((code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE draft_lines(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,draft_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),UNIQUE(draft_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(draft_id)REFERENCES invoice_drafts(id)ON DELETE CASCADE,CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE issued_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,id),UNIQUE(invoice_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE issued_tax_breakdown(invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE proforma_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,id),UNIQUE(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE proforma_tax_breakdown(proforma_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(proforma_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,proforma_id)REFERENCES proformas(organization_id,id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE correction_lines(id TEXT NOT NULL,correction_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,description TEXT NOT NULL,quantity TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price TEXT NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,tax_category TEXT NOT NULL,tax_rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,total_excluding_tax TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,total_including_tax TEXT NOT NULL,unit_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 3),unit_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(unit_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),PRIMARY KEY(correction_id,id),UNIQUE(correction_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(correction_id)REFERENCES correction_documents(id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND tax_rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND tax_rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND tax_rate='5.00' AND tax_category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND tax_rate='0.00' AND tax_category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT

CREATE TABLE correction_tax_breakdown(correction_id TEXT NOT NULL,line_position INTEGER NOT NULL,tax_code TEXT NOT NULL,category TEXT NOT NULL,rate TEXT NOT NULL,vat_exemption_reason TEXT,taxable_amount TEXT NOT NULL,tax_amount TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(correction_id,line_position),FOREIGN KEY(correction_id)REFERENCES correction_documents(id),CHECK((tax_code='RO_STANDARD' AND rate IN('19.00','21.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED' AND rate IN('9.00','11.00') AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_REDUCED_5' AND rate='5.00' AND category='S' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NULL)OR(tax_code='RO_NON_VAT' AND rate='0.00' AND category='O' AND vat_exemption_reason IS NOT NULL AND vat_exemption_reason='Regim special de scutire conform art. 310 din Codul fiscal')))STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER issued_lines_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON issued_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_lines_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued invoice lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_tax_breakdown_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON issued_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued tax breakdown is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_tax_breakdown_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON issued_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued tax breakdown is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_lines WHEN(SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are sealed');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON proforma_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_lines_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proforma_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma lines are immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_no_late_insert BEFORE INSERT ON proforma_tax_breakdown WHEN(SELECT sealed FROM proformas WHERE id=NEW.proforma_id)!=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is sealed');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_breakdown_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON proforma_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER proforma_tax_breakdown_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON proforma_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'proforma tax breakdown is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_lines_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON correction_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_lines_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON correction_lines BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction lines are immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_tax_breakdown_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON correction_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction tax breakdown is immutable');END
CREATE TRIGGER correction_tax_breakdown_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON correction_tax_breakdown BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'correction tax breakdown is immutable');END
